On Wed, Feb 20, 2019 at 11:09 AM Xavier CARTRON <xcartron(dxaviercartron.fr> wrote:
Dear Jeffrey

Hope you are doing well.

With reference to your e-mail below and the attached one, we would like to clarify the following:

1) First of all; Xavier Cartron SAS as a Company never tells its Clients "it is not worth the time to work with you'. On the
contrary, we respect and appreciate every Client and serve him with our best care and knowledge.

2) You summarized all our work effort since months by Bubble Diagrams and some Pen Drawings. This is not accurate.

We want to summarize all the presentations that have been made since we started working together:
- Till date we produced 13 presentations (summary attached).
- Not all presentations are with the same contents or details - some were more basic than the others but nevertheless
correspond to a coherent and evolving work process that we agreed to follow day after day.
- You will find copy of all these presentations under the following link !::.,

i R% >xi2 lip \p

- The effort and contents of these presentations are very important and have very serious ingredients that upon which we
can finalize the Architecture Design not only the master plan.

3) It seems to us that we have done a very Serious Job and in return you still insist that you didn't get anything of value
from all what was done:

- We visited the site 2 times.
- We tried to get a detailed Client Brief over several meetings with you and your team.
- We tried to analyze and resolve the maximum number of the initial constraints, as well as others that have been added
as studies progressed.

EFTA01032820

 - We concluded (more or less) the project programme as a reflection of the main requirements.
- We went beyond our initial scope and we developed detailed plans in order to test the spaces, relations, satisfy your
requirements, etc..
- We modeled the full land and the as-built buildings in order to demonstrate to you that the Architecture that we are
developing is real and not over the sea.
- We gave you all the Architectural Options (with advantages and disadvantages) to make you pick-up one road to follow
and take it further and develop.
-At 2 moments you felt that we need to go back to square one and relook at the main program. We accepted and have
done that happily to assist you in defining what you want although it is not a common practice to us as this results lots of
abortive work.

4) We would like to make a point and analysis of the work done as well as the difficulties that we have faced:

- During each presentation (in your presence) we had positive direct feedback. However, after the presentations the
feedback was systematically negative and insulting.

If you don't feel that we are the right Architects to do your project, this is your total choice that we respect as design is
something subjective - we cannot convince you if you are not convinced on your own. But we don't accept to get more
insults and bad words about our work and our company. We are one of the most reputable companies that has been
commissioned and entrusted by top Clients all over the world to design and build their private and public projects.

For us, we want to continue to work on your project, but you should decide if you want to continue with us or no. So if
you want to advance with your project, we need to take the positive parts of what we did till now and agree on a road
map for the future.

- We believe that we know the island well (especially that we modeled it in 3D) and we fell in love with this beautiful
place. Of course we do not have your knowledge of every inche of the island, this is why your explanations helped us to
develop the project.

We have no objection to design on site — we can discuss that in details and its costs accompanied.

- The bubble diagrams we sent you may look like simple work but it is the contrary. We believe this is the correct step (at
this stage) for one to sit around the table and together analyze and conclude.

- As we informed you previously, we were expecting after the last meeting in Pads that you chose One General Scheme /
Option and based on which we can start the Design Development Phase (with a New Higher Level Detailed Scope of
Work, Involvement and Contract) to cover the following tasks:
■ Design Development of One Architectural Option
■ Interior Design and Landscape Design Concept Design and further Detailed Design
■ Engaging Engineering Office to work in parallel with us on the Project Design Development (Geotechnical, MEP
Structure, Wind Testing, Hurricanes…
